distribution.summary: Inner Mongolia; Shaanxi; Gansu; Qinghai; Sichuan; Shanxi; Xizang; Yunnan
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Inner Mongolia (Helan Mountains), Shaanxi (Shiquan), Gansu (Sunan, Xiaolai, Zhangye), Qinghai (Xining, Zeku) under the name Polygraphus polygraphus. Huang & Lu (2015) reported Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai under the name Polygraphus polygraphus. These are literature-based records; Mainland China remains Candidate pending occurrence review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Sichuan, Shanxi, Xizang, Yunnan as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.
